title: Comparison Criteria for First Order Polynomial Differential Equations
content: In this paper we use the comparison method for investigation of  first order polynomial differential equations. We prove two  comparison criteria for these equations. The proved  criteria we use  to obtain some global solvability criteria for first order polynomial differential equations. On the basis od these criteria  we prove some criteria for existence of a closed solution (of closed solutions)   for first order polynomial differential equations. The results obtained we compare with some known results. Based on obtained results some criteria of existence of periodic orbits or limit cycles for planar autonomous systems are proved.
